description: Source code for the FnPlugin struct and related functions in the kustomize project, implementing plugin configuration, resource transformation, and plugin invocation logic.

classes.name: FnPlugin
classes.description: Struct representing a kustomize plugin with methods for configuration, generation, and transformation.

methods.name: bytesToRNode
methods.description: Converts YAML bytes to a yaml.RNode object.

methods.name: resourceToRNode
methods.description: Converts a resource.Resource to a yaml.RNode.

methods.name: GetFunctionSpec
methods.description: Retrieves the FunctionSpec from a resource.Resource.

methods.name: toStorageMounts
methods.description: Converts a list of string mounts to runtimeutil.StorageMount objects.

methods.name: NewFnPlugin
methods.description: Creates a new FnPlugin instance with specified options.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Loads plugin configuration and metadata from provided bytes.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates resources by invoking the plugin as a generator.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms a resource map using the plugin as a transformer.

methods.name: injectAnnotation
methods.description: Adds an annotation to a yaml.RNode.

methods.name: invokePlugin
methods.description: Executes the plugin function with given input bytes and returns output bytes.
